transcript.content: Required validation errors appear for read-only panels T26886 - Skip “required” validation when a question is read-only (or has a read-only parent) https://surveyjs.answerdesk.io/internal/ticket/details/T26886 *** ``` { "pages": [ { "name": "page1", "elements": [ { "type": "panel", "name": "panel1", "readOnly": true, "title": "Required Panel", "isRequired": true, "elements": [ { "type": "text", "name": "question1" } ] } ] } ] } ``` If a panel is read-only, it still displays required validation errors: The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find in the survey-core source (src/panel.ts) the panel validation code handling isRequired (hasRequiredError / hasErrorsCore / validate) and how question.ts skips required validation for read-only. Report the relevant code snippets with line numbers.

content.content: {"summary":"In this version panel.ts has no hasRequiredError or hasErrorsCore; I found neither name in panel.ts or question.ts. Panel validation uses hasErrors, validate, validateCore, validateInPanels and validateRequired. Question.ts has hasRequiredError, and it skips validation for read-only questions through canCollectErrors rather than inside hasRequiredError. I did not read where validateElementCore (called at question.ts:2499) gets to checkForErrors, and I did not check the settings.readOnly.enableValidation default.","findings":["Files are under /testbed/packages/survey-core/src/. A grep for hasErrorsCore in panel.ts and question.ts returned nothing.","panel.ts:937 `@property() isRequired: boolean;` is the panel's required flag. panel.ts:395 has `requiredIf` setting `this.isRequired = res === true`.","panel.ts:953-954 `hasErrors(fireCallback, focusOnFirstError)` returns `!this.validate(fireCallback, focusOnFirstError)`.","panel.ts:962-970 `validate()` builds a ValidationContext, calls `this.validateCore(context)`, then `context.finish()`, and returns `context.runningResult`.","panel.ts:1012-1032 `validateCore(context)` handles the single-input question case. It loops over the elements and skips any that are not visible. Nested panels recurse into their own `validateCore`. Questions get `question.validateElement(context)`. If there is no singleQ it then calls `validateInPanels(context)` and `updateContainsErrors()`.","panel.ts:978-988 `validateInPanels` collects errors from `validateRequired(context, errors)`. If there is a survey it runs `validationCallbacks.validatePanel` and `context.setErrorElement(this, errors)`. When `context.fireCallback` is true it assigns `this.errors = errors`.","panel.ts:995-1005 `validateRequired` returns at once if the panel is not required. It gathers visible questions with `addQuestionsToList(visQuestions, true)`. It returns with no error if there are none, or if any of them is non-empty. Otherwise it pushes `new OneAnswerRequiredError(this.requiredErrorText, this)` and calls `context.setErrorElement(visQuestions[0], [error])`. This is the panel-level 'at least one answer' rule. It has no read-only check.","panel.ts:1007-1011 `validateElement(context)` returns true when the error count has not grown after `validateCore`.","question.ts:2473-2474 `hasErrors` returns `!this.validateCore(fireCallback, false, focusOnFirstError)`. question.ts:2481-2499 `validate` and the private `validateCore` build a ValidationContext, call `validateElement`, then `finish()`. If `isRoot && isOnValueChanged && this.parent`, `validateCore` first calls `parent.validateContainerOnly()`.","question.ts:2556-2562 `checkForErrors` runs `collectErrors` only when `this.isVisible && this.canCollectErrors()`. This is where read-only questions skip required validation.","question.ts:2572-2574 `canCollectErrors()` returns `!this.isReadOnly || settings.readOnly.enableValidation`. A read-only question is therefore not validated unless that setting is enabled.","question.ts:2576 `collectErrors` calls `onCheckForErrors`, then runs validators unless errors already exist or `canRunValidators` is false.","question.ts:2590-2596 `onCheckForErrors` pushes `AnswerRequiredError` when `(!isOnValueChanged || this.isOldAnswered) && this.hasRequiredError()`.","question.ts:2603-2605 `hasRequiredError()` returns `this.isRequired && this.isEmpty()`. It has no read-only check itself.","question.ts:1741 defines `isReadOnly`. It also takes the parent panel's and parent question's read-only state into account (lines 1742-1743)."],"confidence":0.85}
